hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: raw SEC Companyfacts goodwill/asset impairment overhang relief, where a prior material impairment burden fades sharply in the latest annual filing while revenue is not collapsing, paired with liquid SPY-relative leadership, may identify turnaround continuation after non-cash cleanup pressure fades.

prediction.confidence_reason: Recent raw Companyfacts quality ratios are saturated, but impairment relief is a different overhang-cleanup event field rather than working-capital, debt, lease, D&A, or CapEx productivity; disconfirmers are sparse/nonzero impairment rows and value-trap behavior after next-open costs.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC annual revenue pair, missing prior annual revenue comparison, insufficient prior impairment burden, stale filed facts, missing CIK mapping, excluded sector, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC tag mapping, filed-date PIT impairment-overhang relief gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The raw SEC impairment-overhang relief source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, drawdown_drift_too_high, target_concentration_failed, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). It is not retained or promoted. The positive aggregate is not robust: old_thin regressed, max drawdown drift exceeded the guardrail, and positive incremental PnL was dominated by APP at 94.5% of positive contribution, so the field behaves like a concentrated turnaround/momentum overlay rather than an independent repeatable candidate source.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.0731; aggregate PnL delta $+618.02; max drawdown drift +0.0072; 84 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping impairment tag lists, impairment-burden thresholds, revenue floor, sector exclusions, annual fact freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs materially different PIT overhang evidence, such as impairment footnote semantics, disposal/segment context, closed forward replacement-value rows, or a shared daily helper that proves the same filed-date field is observable. Do not sweep impairment tags, burden thresholds, revenue floor, sector exclusions, freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
